FULL SCREEN ON IPHONE


Safari can't hide its bars for a web game. Install it to your Home Screen and it opens full screen.


  1. Tap Share ⬆ in Safari's toolbar.
  2. Scroll down, tap Add to Home Screen.
  3. Make sure Open as Web App is on if you see it, tap Add.
  4. Close Safari. Launch MT Mania from the icon.


Already have an icon and it still opens with Safari's bars? Delete it and add it again from Safari. Opened from the GitHub app or another app's browser? Tap the compass/Safari button first so you're in real Safari.
